relevance.rationale: Extends Cheeger-Müller analytic = combinatorial torsion equality from unitary to unimodular SL_n(C) representations on closed odd-dimensional manifolds.

keyResults.statement: For any acyclic unimodular representation of pi_1(M) on a closed odd-dimensional manifold M, Ray-Singer analytic torsion equals combinatorial Reidemeister torsion.
keyResults.useForFolio: Necessary bridge between combinatorial R-torsion and spectral Laplace determinants for non-unitary SL_2(C) representations, with strict boundary caveat that cusped manifolds require cusp-surgery control.
